svg.title: Three educational prediction interfaces
svg.desc: Original conceptual diagram, not reproduced research architecture or execution evidence. World model predicts later state, representation predictor predicts target features, action policy predicts actions.

g.text: Original teaching schematic · not an experimental result
state / observation + action → dynamics predictor → next state / features
visible context → encoder + predictor → target features (not necessarily pixels)
observation + instruction → policy → action (not a next-state prediction)
Paper-only exercise. No weights, external data, model calls or robot control.
